text: Grab's FY2025 report states that in Indonesia, media reports indicate the government is considering a **draft presidential decree** that would reduce the maximum commission Grab can charge driver-partners. Currently, under Ministry of Transportation ("MOT") Decree No. 667 of 2022 (as amended), the cap is 20% (comprising a 15% commission cap plus a 5% optional supporting fee cap). If the draft decree is adopted as reported, this would be lowered to a **flat 10% commission cap**. The draft decree would also reportedly reclassify driver-partners as quasi-employees (requiring Grab to fund insurance and pension/health contributions), allow government review of driver-partner agreements, and protect unionization rights [Grab, FY2025, p.16].
